Windows-only portable ZIP + Setup EXE reliability update (owner-authorized). Adds non-destructive Windows SharedPreferences recovery from known historical profile locations and a local profile snapshot, without overwriting existing values. Root cause of the owner's missing configuration remains unverified without device diagnostics; secure credentials cannot be reconstructed from absent local storage. Night Mode uses Windows-specific 4:1 acompressor with bounded 1.25 makeup gain and FFmpeg alimiter limit 0.95 while retaining normalized surround downmix, speed and fail-open behavior. Windows Extra Brightness uses native lavfi video EQ rather than relying solely on renderer-dependent mpv brightness, with fallback on setter failure. New opt-in Windows Debug Mode diagnostics record actual MPV audio/video filter, decoder and safe storage status and can upload allowlisted properties to the private TorriODB when GitHub Library credentials exist. Debug Mode OFF remains no log writes or telemetry; iOS Build #155 is unchanged. Linux and Windows shared-source gates passed on commit 3186e2b6d58be503dfdbd7c37f527682867562fe. Native packaged MPV PCM, 6-channel E-AC3 and synthetic video-filter tests are required before publishing; no owner-device acoustic or 4K visual success claimed.
